description: English Wikipedia pages for Hundred Years' War reference notes. Keep this list at battle, siege, raid, or campaign scale.

pages.title: Hundred Years' War
pages.note: Broad context only. Use specific battles, sieges, and campaigns for tactical extraction.

pages.title: Battle of Sluys
pages.note: Naval melee, immobilized ships, missile fire, and control of channel access.

pages.title: Battle of Crécy
pages.note: Defensive position, English longbow, dismounted men-at-arms, and disorderly cavalry assaults.

pages.title: Siege of Calais (1346–1347)
pages.note: Long blockade, coastal logistics, starvation pressure, and strategic port capture.

pages.title: Battle of Poitiers
pages.note: Defensive terrain, longbow fire, dismounted combat, and capture of the French king.

pages.title: Battle of Agincourt
pages.note: Mud, narrow frontage, longbow archers, stakes, and compressed French assault.

pages.title: Battle of Orléans
pages.note: Relief of a besieged city, morale reversal, artillery and fortification pressure, and Joan of Arc's role.

pages.title: Battle of Patay
pages.note: Rapid cavalry attack, English archers caught before preparing positions, and reversal after Orléans.

pages.title: Battle of Castillon
pages.note: Field fortifications, artillery position, failed assault, and end-stage tactical transition.
